==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>SpoilerTV|show=''Show Name''|''episode number''}}</code>

#The template currently defaults <code>show</code> to the ''[[Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi]]'', and the episode numbers and names are defined at [[Template:SpoilerTV/data]].
#Insert template at the top of the page, immediately below the {{Tl|Top}} and disambiguation templates, if they are on the page. {{C|see the [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide#Spoiler tag|Layout Guide]]}}
#*For multiple episodes, more parameters may be added to the end of the template.
#The spoiler's expiry date {{C|see the [[Wookieepedia:Spoilers|spoiler policy]]}} will automatically be determined based on the episode number in the first parameter. Then, on that day, the article will be listed on [[:Category:Articles with expired spoiler notices]] to make removing/updating expired spoiler templates more convenient for editors. Also, between 11:00 UTC and 11:59 UTC that day, {{U|C4-DE Bot}} will automatically either remove the entire template or, where applicable, update it according to the episodes listed there.

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{SpoilerTV}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
{{SpoilerTV}}

<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{SpoilerTV|1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
{{SpoilerTV|1}}

<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{SpoilerTV|1|2}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
{{SpoilerTV|1|2}}

<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{SpoilerTV|show=Ahsoka}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
{{SpoilerTV|show=Ahsoka}}
